name: Adult Depression (LGHC Indicator 24)
survey: California Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey, run by the Public Health Survey Research Program at California State University, Sacramento
file: adult_depression_lghc_indicator_24.csv, saved from adult-depression-lghc-indicator-24.csv and otherwise unchanged
covers: California adults, 2012 to 2018, overall and by sex, age, income, education and race or ethnicity
measures: Share of adults ever told by a health professional that they have a depressive disorder, with 95% confidence limits
caution: Weighting uses California Department of Finance population figures, not the U.S. Census. See finding 2 on 2017.
